summary.intent: Work through the NEXT-WORK plan lanes: fix W2 (SYS-RETRY) so a release rerun after a failed tag push completes, add W1's apply mixed-routing test, and do W0's docs refresh and branch cleanup.
summary.outcome: Opened three PRs (#202 SYS-RETRY fix, #203 mixed-routing test, #204 docs refresh), each with `just ci` passing. W0 branch deletion and the W1 real-service credential check were deferred pending the user's decisions.

repo: Each work item is done in its own worktree off origin/main under .claude/worktrees/, and edits are only allowed inside the current worktree, so fixing another PR's docs requires ExitWorktree/EnterWorktree to switch.
`just ci` is the gate (90% line coverage threshold). Background runs must be judged by the log's own `exit=` line, not the task-notification exit code, which only reports the wrapper script.

Release rerun selection previously treated 'tag exists on HEAD' as released, which was the SYS-RETRY defect. Now a package with its version tagged on HEAD has registry, tag and GitHub release observed, and stays selected until all are satisfied. A tag on an older commit still settles without contacting providers.
Three existing tests (init preview, two in release/local.rs) assumed a tag on HEAD means released, so they were changed to tag an older commit.
The release e2e harness log now records read-only calls, so no-op assertions compare mutating calls only.

Spec changes live in docs/specs/release.json (REL-CMD-01, REL-CMD-08, REL-RERUN-02), alongside docs/architecture/release.md and the ADR docs/adr/0003. Changesets are added with the built binary, and the SYS-RETRY change is a callisto-cli patch changeset.
AGENTS.md says not to put session links in commits or PRs.
The plan JSON V1-SYSTEM-HARDENING.json round-trips byte-exact, so scripted pruning is safe.
Many local branches are squash-merged, so `git branch --merged` cannot identify which are safe to delete.

code.finding: Roster derivation gained a 'resumable' set of releases already tagged at HEAD that are still incomplete.
The local plan observes releases already tagged at HEAD via a new capability.rs helper before deciding selection.
Described the old rerun behavior as a known gap and had to be updated after the fix.
The mixed-routing test was shown to fail when the persist in the mixed workspace rewrite is dropped and when the mixed bump order is reversed.

workflow: Write the failing reproduction first and confirm it fails on the old code (it failed with 'Nothing to release.') before implementing.
When a new test passes first try, prove it can fail with mutations (drop a persist, reorder steps), then revert and confirm only the test file changed.
The sandbox rejects inline `env` commands, heredocs, and inline scripts mentioning `git`, and macOS sed rejects some one-liners. Workarounds were script/temp files, the Edit tool, and the Write tool.
A quoted heredoc with backslash-escaped backticks leaves literal backslashes in the PR body. Write the body to a file instead and check the rendered PR.
Don't delete branches without per-branch confirmation.

friction: Sandbox restrictions on inline env, heredocs and git-mentioning scripts forced repeated workarounds via temp script files.
The first `just ci` failed with exit=100 on init::tests::preview_matches_release_dry_run_without_writing, and then on two more local.rs tests, all because they relied on the defective premise.
The PR body for #202 had literal backslashes from escaped backticks and needed a fix.
Background sessions can't edit the shared checkout, so .claude/plans/NEXT-WORK.md could not be updated with PR status.
The sandbox only allows edits inside the current worktree, forcing worktree switches to patch #202 docs.
The macOS sed one-liner for fixing imports failed.
open_items: Delete stale remote and local branches, per branch with user approval. Remote branches that aren't the assistant's: docs/next-work-plan, docs/spec-rewrite, fix/native-resolution. About 35 local branches remain, and some, like pr/v1-current-contract, may carry unpushed commits.
W1 real-service credential check needs the user's decision on where it runs in CI.
Follow-up edit to #204 after #202 merges: SYS-RETRY and T08-RETRY entries in the roadmap, plan JSON and guide still reference the fixed item.
No independent review yet of #202, which the plan recommends before merging risky changes.
Real `gh`, `cargo` and registry reads are faked by the harness and unproven against real services.
A preview without an `origin` push URL cannot observe, so it keeps the old behavior.
Update .claude/plans/NEXT-WORK.md with PR status from a non-background session.
Next lanes not started: Lane D (R3 derive.rs snapshots/moves, then SYS-BARRIER) and Lane E (R5 init.rs moves, then SYS-NAPI).
